learning_outcomes.text: To have knowledge about the basic concepts in computational fluid dynamics
To have knowledge about partial differential equations and their solutions
Students will have knowledge about commercial CFD software and its use

syllabus_topics: Finite Volume Discretization of Diffusion Equation - (Time-Independent, Source Term-Free, One Dimensional)
Finite Volume Discretization of Diffusion Equation - (Time Independent, Source Term, One Dimensional)
Finite Volume Discretization of Diffusion Equation - (Time Independent, Source Term, One Dimensional)
Finite Volume Discretization of Diffusion Equation - (Time Dependent, No Source Term, One Dimension)
CFD Lab - Simulation of Laminar Flow Through Channel
CFD Lab - Time Independent Over-Cylinder Flow Simulation
CFD Lab - Simulation of Time Dependent Flow Over Cylinder
CFD Lab - Centrifugal Fan Time Independent Simulation
CFD Lab - Centrifugal Fan Time Dependent Simulation
bibliography: Versteeg, H. K. and Malalasekera, W., “An Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics”, İkinci Baskı, 2007.
Patankar, S. V., “Numerical Heat Transfer and Fluid Flow”, McGraw-Hill, 1980.
Zengin, İ. (2024) Hesaplamalı Akışkanlar Dinamiği Ders Notları. BEUN Mühendislik Fakültesi, Makine Mühendisliği Bölümü. Zonguldak.
